exposure: individualized feedback delivered via secure messaging platform
outcome: feasibility of the deep-learning system for nipple trauma assessment
cohort: Postpartum mothers at a maternity hospital, assigned to an intervention group using a smartphone-based nipple trauma assessment system or a control group.
finding: The deep-learning-based nipple trauma assessment system was found to be feasible, acceptable, and safe during postpartum hospitalization, with participants finding the AI results useful and the intervention group showing a greater improvement in breastfeeding self-efficacy scores.
